name: Object-NeRF
definition: Composition model that separates and edits objects within a scene using a hybrid voxel-based approach with jointly optimized voxel grid features and MLP parameters.
summary: Object-NeRF is a composition model that separates and edits objects within a scene using a hybrid voxel-based approach, differing from standard volume rendering by explicitly partitioning the radiance field into distinct scene and object branches.
